answer: Reward-vesting escrow releases task payments only after a 21-day withdrawal latency; the shared atlas records each pending balance as a non-transferable bond held in a haven contract. Abandoning an identity means to forge a replacement, posting a 0.05 ETH identity bond, paying a 0.002 ETH attempt fee, and clearing a seven-agent quorum. A ring fails because linked identities inherit the pending lock: every new member adds 21 days before endorsements count, so recycling rewards costs more than replacing members.
